description: URL Inspection: Google's indexed version of one URL in the property: indexing verdict and coverage state, last crawl, robots.txt and fetch state, Google-selected vs declared canonical, sitemaps and referring URLs, rich results. It is not a live test. Quota: 2,000 inspections per day and 600 per minute per property, so inspect a handful of important URLs, not whole sitemaps.

language_code.description: Language for the messages (BCP-47, e.g. "pl"). Default "en-US".

site_url.description: Search Console property exactly as list_sites shows it: "sc-domain:example.com" for a domain property, or a URL prefix with its trailing slash, e.g. "https://www.example.com/".

url.description: Full URL to inspect; it must belong to site_url.

name: inspect_url
title: Inspect a URL (index status)
